3. Owen: The legacy_exporter service cannot switch readers atomically and requires exactly 14 days of dual-write coverage before the old pipeline reader can be disabled. This directly impacts our transition settings and means dual-write needs to start by January 18, 2026 to complete before the February 1 retirement date. Please get your local migration note formalized and submitted.

Before I settle on the final plan, does anyone see any conflicts between these constraints, or are there any other considerations I should be aware of?
